Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a safety-tier review. I reviewed the trial merge with upstream main `2f965f7d97311a33baaf147a3f29d3933eb0c0af` locally.

The change removes the unsupported travel limit. The post still refuses overtravel when a machine states finite limits. The tests check both directions and the boundary values.

I confirmed the continuous A-axis description in Tormach UM10349, version 0520A, page 104 ([manual copy](https://device.report/m/b4b8b3ba84abba151840071cbd82e79808b3e8c0f774ef51a8a9f31495bf5f56)). I also read the [recorded PathPilot Hub result](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/2386#issuecomment-6968650463).

Local results:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Trial merge | Clean |
| Selected post and app test builds (`--no-run`) | Pass |
| `tormach_rotary_travel` | 5 pass |
| `tormach_fourth_axis` | 12 pass |
| `tormach_wrapped_a` | 13 pass |
| `first_4axis_part` | 4 pass |

| Clippy for `camcraft-post` and `camcraft-app`, all targets, `-D warnings` | Pass |
| `git diff --check upstream/main` | Pass |

Mutation checks: I restored upstream's machine file temporarily. These four tests failed, as required:

- `microarc_states_no_a_soft_limit_and_cites_sources`
- `microarc_posts_multi_turn_rotary_offset_past_four_turns`
- `shipped_microarc_posts_wrapped_a_past_four_turns`
- `the_microarc_machine_states_an_a_about_x`

I restored the PR file. All three affected Rust suites then passed. No mutation remains.

The existing MicroARC failure is:

```text
wrap_rotary_parallel_microarc4.nc: line count 3246 != 3245
```

It fails identically with upstream's unchanged machine file. The site failure is at `site/tests/test_first_4axis_part.py:181`. It searches `posting.rs` for a registry entry that moved to `posting_files.rs`. The upstream test has the same failure. Neither failure comes from this change.

No golden file moved. No UI file changed, so before/after screenshots are not required. I found no blocking law violation. The decision record and the Changelog line are present.

Requested before merge: none.

Notes: The gate planner included unrelated upstream changes because the trial merge has no commit. I selected the affected suites directly. I did not run the full gate, Zola, UI tests, PathPilot, or hardware tests. No GitHub runner was used.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 17e60d30a71e7479cae0fc0f5e4639070edb7d64 -->
**Verdict: merge-ready**

Second review (safety floor: machine travel and posted G-code). I found no blocker.

**What replaces the limit.** The `arc4` rotary now states no `travel`. `parse_mch` gives `travel: None`, and `mirror_rotaries` writes no `travel` key. By the unstated-limit law this is "no limit" (continuous rotary). It is not a skipped check by error:
- `assets/posts/tormach.cps:655-657` sets `aAxis.travel` to `null`. The two refusals at `:730` and `:737` then do not apply. All other A logic stays the same.
- The A word stays cumulative. The turn is the short way (`d - 360 * round(d / 360)`), added to the held angle. There is no modulo on the posted word, so a multi-turn value does not reverse direction.
- The next operation restates its first angle in -180..180 after `G53 G0 Z`. A1500 thus unwinds at the top of Z. This is the same unwind that #796 read in the Hub (400 deg).
- `crates/app/src/machine/judge.rs:98` and `:168` skip the A range check on `None`. `crates/post/src/kinematics/travel.rs:98` maps `None` to an infinite range. No code divides by a range. The A range has no part in the index swing check or in the stock simulation.

**Source.** The decision file and `general.description` name UM10587 / UM10864 / UM10349 (Rotational Axis), TD10749 and the Hub readings (#796, PR #2386). The first review confirmed UM10349 page 104. This answers the open question of #2471. The decision file drops a large invented bound by the law, and gives the cost to put a bound back.

**Tests.** The shipped file posts +/-1500 deg (`microarc_posts_multi_turn_rotary_offset_past_four_turns`, `shipped_microarc_posts_wrapped_a_past_four_turns`). A bounded copy (-360..360, -100..100) still refuses by name (`a_count_past_the_travel_is_refused_by_name`, the two `*_a_overtravel_*` tests, `an_a_past_travel_is_refused`). No other machine file changed. No golden or snapshot PNG changed. The Gate map lines are present. The PR changes no process file. The trial merge with the current main is clean.

**Non-blockers:**
1. `site/content/guide/multi-axis/_index.md:33` still says "A about X, -360 to 360 degrees" for this machine. The PR leaves it for PR #2346. Please file a follow-up if #2346 does not change that row.
2. `crates/app/tests/tormach_fourth_axis.rs` has 464 lines. It was already past 400 on main, and this PR adds no lines. `tormach_wrapped_a.rs` is now 399 lines.
3. `microarc_test_part` fails on main (`wrap_rotary_parallel_microarc4.nc: line count 3246 != 3245`). It is not from this PR. Please make sure an issue tracks it.

Read from the diff. Not built. Second review (safety floor) by an agent that did not write the change.
